'''Jan-gwa''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Unlike many other Gungan cities, it was only partially located underwater. The cliff behind it had several faces carved into its walls.
